stories.title: ‘Someone has to go out on a limb’: What to know about Bernie Sanders’ newest AI pitch
stories.simple_summary: Bernie Sanders has made a new proposal related to AI policy. The details of his specific plan aren't clear from the headline alone.
stories.why_it_matters: This is about politics and policy — it may or may not affect you depending on what rules get made, but there's nothing you need to do right now.

stories.title: OpenAI’s president claims AI is as capable as humans now
stories.simple_summary: An OpenAI leader says their AI tool can now do things just as well as a human can. This is a big claim they're making about their technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and tech companies thinking about what AI can do — for your daily life, AI tools still work better for some tasks than others, just like before.

stories.title: OpenAI hails ‘new era of artificial general intelligence’ with Astra model release
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI released a new AI model called Astra and says it marks the beginning of a new level of artificial intelligence capability.
stories.why_it_matters: OpenAI is excited about their new tool, but whether it actually changes anything for regular people depends on how it gets used — we'll see over time.

stories.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra on ARC-AGI-3
stories.simple_summary: This is a technical announcement about OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra model being tested on a benchmark called ARC-AGI-3.
stories.why_it_matters: This is technical information for engineers and investors — nothing you need to know about right now.

stories.title: LAUSD adopts moratorium on student AI use, another big move to limit classroom computer time
stories.simple_summary: Los Angeles schools have decided to stop letting students use AI tools in the classroom for now. They're hitting pause to think more carefully about it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you have kids or grandkids in LA schools, they won't be using AI helpers for their schoolwork — the school wants them to learn without that assistance for now.

stories.title: Accel reportedly in talks to lead $1B round for Thinking Machines at $40B valuation
stories.simple_summary: Investors are considering giving a company called Thinking Machines a very large amount of money. This is mainly a story about investment deals.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people with money in tech funds — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Abliteration.ai is making a business out of removing AI guardrails
stories.simple_summary: A company called Abliteration.ai is making it easier for people to use AI tools that don't have safety limits. They say this could help with cybersecurity.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a risky area — removing safety guards from AI could make it easier for bad actors to misuse AI, even if some argue it has defensive benefits.

stories.title: Meta is paying to peek at how you use their latest AI model
stories.simple_summary: Meta is offering a big discount on their new AI model if you let them watch how you use it and keep a copy of what you type and the results.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Meta's AI tools, be aware they may want to study your usage in exchange for lower prices — read the terms if you're interested.

stories.title: OpenAI launches Astra, its powerful (and controversial) new model
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI has released a new AI model called Astra that they say can do computer tasks very quickly and accurately.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a new powerful tool from OpenAI, similar to their other AI releases — whether it matters to you depends on what you'd use it for.

stories.title: OpenAI’s next big AI model has ‘entered the AGI era’
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, which they say is a major jump forward in AI ability, especially for jobs like cybersecurity and computer programming.
stories.why_it_matters: This is another announcement about OpenAI's new AI — it's getting more powerful, but it mostly affects software developers and tech professionals right now.

stories.title: Nvidia strikes $12.9bn deal to buy AI platform Hugging Face
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia, a big computer chip company, is buying Hugging Face, which is a company that hosts AI tools and code, for about $13 billion.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — Nvidia is betting big on AI by buying a major hub for AI development, but this doesn't directly change what you can do with AI.

stories.title: Nvidia to spend $13 billion on Hugging Face, which will remain an open source platform - ABC News
stories.source: Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia is spending $13 billion to buy Hugging Face, and the company will stay as an open platform (meaning people can still use and share tools freely on it).
stories.why_it_matters: This is a large business deal — Nvidia is investing heavily in AI, but this doesn't change what tools are available or how you'd use them.
